DETERMINATION: ADVERSE DETERMINATION - MEDICAL NECESSITY

This letter is notice that Meridian Health Plan has issued an adverse determination on the basis of medical necessity for the inpatient admission identified above. The request for coverage of the inpatient level of care has been denied. This adverse determination was made following review of the submitted medical record against the applicable InterQual-style criteria set in effect for the admission.

BASIS FOR DETERMINATION

The medical record does not document clinical severity sufficient to require inpatient admission.

Criteria reviewed and found not met:

COPD-02: Not met. Payer finding: Symptoms improved with emergency department treatment.

COPD-03: Not met. Payer finding: Noninvasive ventilation was not required on a sustained basis.

No additional criteria codes were applied in reaching this adverse determination.

CLAIM ADJUSTMENT CODING

The following codes will appear on the associated remittance advice:

CARC CO-50
RARC N115

This adverse determination addresses medical necessity only. The member is not liable for charges denied under CARC CO-50 except as permitted by the provider agreement and applicable law.

APPEAL RIGHTS

The member, or a provider acting as the member's authorized representative, may request a Level 1 appeal of this medical necessity adverse determination. Appeals may be submitted by letter or by portal upload. The appeal submission should cite the criteria codes inline, specifically COPD-02 and COPD-03, and should state the basis on which the submitter believes each was met. Please attach the History and Physical and the progress notes covering the admission. Appeal submissions are subject to a five page limit, excluding the attached records described above.

Appeals must be received by [[APPEAL_DEADLINE]]. Submissions received after that date may not be eligible for Level 1 review.

A copy of the criteria used in this review is available on request at no charge. A clinical peer reviewer is available to discuss this adverse determination with the treating provider upon request.

Signed,
Medical Director, Utilization Management
Meridian Health Plan
